variable_signal_definition: Shared-domain excess reads have a 0.02 acceptance weight in one staggered 20%-wide interior window per library; the remaining excess signal is retained. Domain envelopes remain the fixed truth, with an explicit low-signal interior.
scope: New aligned-read synthetic data and new seeds, separate from all frozen benchmarks and the HP1/H3K27me3 development data. Tests caller-to-provider behavior, not alignment, mappability, repeats, sample preparation or biological generalization.

truth_definitions.candidate: Union of known enriched domains present in at least one library; includes library-specific signal.
truth_definitions.shared: Known enriched domains present in at least two libraries; excludes private domains.
truth_definitions.domain_recovered: At least 50% of domain bases covered.
truth_definitions.substantial_overlap: At least 500 bp OR at least 10% of truth-domain width.
truth_definitions.fragmented: More than one output interval has substantial overlap with one truth domain.
truth_definitions.merged: An output interval has substantial overlap with more than one distinct truth domain.

gates.shared_domain_recall_by_width: The same scenario-specific minimum applies separately to each nonempty width class; aggregate success must not hide failure in short domains.

decision_policy: Report each seed/scenario independently; any unmet gate remains a failure. No threshold changes, seed exclusion, automatic default promotion or retrospective benchmark edits. Gates are prospective engineering/scientific acceptance criteria for this validation, not universal community standards or estimates of FDR.
reproducible_occupancy: Not asserted by the provider or by synthetic acceptance; requires an appropriate design and independently validated evidence model.
